policy: Every reading is a frozen blood_constraints row function and every verdict its frozen passes(), primary reading only. A constraint whose table keys exclude the bleed rate is evaluated once and rejects at every rate (exact pre-filter, reported apart). Then each case is read in the order U-OUT, U-HB, FD-BLD-08, FD-BLD-06 and stops at its first readable failure; an UNREADABLE reading (its frozen function raises) never counts as a failure or as a bound. A candidate SURVIVES when both cases meet every constraint, is REJECTED when either case fails one, and is UNREADABLE otherwise. Positions outside the case band are REJECTED_BY_CASE_TRUTH_COMPATIBILITY without simulation. FD-BLD-03 is not read.
